title: Optimizing Global Retail Infrastructure Costs
business: A global retail chain managing diverse cloud-based inventory systems across multiple geographic regions.
problem: The organization faces unpredictable monthly cloud expenditures due to decentralized resource provisioning, making it difficult to identify which specific regional services are driving cost spikes.
solution: AWS Cost Explorer provides a centralized interface to visualize usage and cost trends, allowing the finance team to aggregate data by region, service, and usage type to pinpoint inefficiencies.
steps: Enable Cost Explorer in the AWS Billing and Cost Management console to begin data collection.
Define custom cost allocation tags to categorize resources by department and regional retail project.
Configure granular filters in the Cost Explorer dashboard to isolate spending by specific AWS service and region.
Generate monthly forecast reports to anticipate future spending based on historical usage patterns.
Review automated recommendations for Reserved Instances or Savings Plans to optimize identified high-cost areas.
outcome: The organization gains clear visibility into regional spending patterns, enabling proactive budget management and the identification of underutilized resources that can be decommissioned or right-sized.
limitation: Cost Explorer data is typically delayed by up to 24 hours, meaning it cannot be used for real-time cost monitoring or immediate automated shutdown of runaway resources; users must check the 'Data freshness' indicator in the console to verify the latest available timestamp.
